responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend’s internal ABI classification used for extern functions and calling convention selection. The file defines the Rust::ABI enum for Rust, intrinsic, and target C-family ABIs and exposes the conversion helpers that map between source-level ABI strings and the compiler’s normalized representation.
same_name_distinction: Provides the ABI type definition and function declarations shared by the Rust frontend; unlike gcc/rust/util/rust-abi.cc, it does not perform any ABI name translation itself, but specifies the enum values and interfaces the implementation uses.
